2026-09-01 (Tuesday), timezone UTC, locale en-GB.

SKILLS
roundTo — Round a number to a number of decimal places or significant figures.
  needs: value: number, places: integer
  optional: mode: string
  e.g. "round 3.14159 to 2 decimal places" → {"value":3.14159,"places":2}
sum — Add up a list of numbers and give the total.
  needs: values: array
  e.g. "add up 1250, 3400 and 890" → {"values":[1250,3400,890]}
allocateProportionally — Split an amount across shares in proportion to their weights.
  needs: total: number, weights: array
  optional: labels: array, decimals: integer
  e.g. "share 100 out in equal parts between three" → {"total":100,"weights":[1,1,1]}
evaluateExpression — Work out an arithmetic expression exactly. Reads % as a percentage.
  needs: expression: string
  optional: decimals: integer
  e.g. "what's (18.5 * 12) / 4" → {"expression":"(18.5 * 12) / 4"}
factorial — Work out a factorial — the product of every whole number up to n.
  needs: n: integer
  e.g. "what is 10 factorial" → {"n":10}
fibonacci — Give the nth Fibonacci number, or the first n of them.
  needs: n: integer
  optional: mode: string
  e.g. "what is the 10th fibonacci number" → {"n":10}
formatCurrency — Write an amount of money the way a currency is normally written, with its symbol and decimal places.
  needs: amount: number, currency: string
  optional: style: string
  e.g. "write 1234.5 as pounds" → {"amount":1234.5,"currency":"GBP"}
formatNumber — Write a number with thousands separators, a set number of decimals, or in compact form like 1.2k.
  needs: value: number
  optional: decimals: integer, style: string
  e.g. "format 1234567 with thousands separators" → {"value":1234567}
fractionSimplify — Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms.
  needs: fraction: string
  e.g. "simplify 6/8" → {"fraction":"6/8"}
gcd — Find the greatest common divisor — the largest number that divides a set of whole numbers exactly.
  needs: values: array
  e.g. "greatest common divisor of 48 and 18" → {"values":[48,18]}
isPrime — Say whether a whole number is prime, and give a divisor if it is not.
  needs: value: integer
  e.g. "is 97 prime" → {"value":97}
lcm — Find the lowest common multiple — the smallest number that a set of whole numbers all divide into.
  needs: values: array
  e.g. "lowest common multiple of 4 and 6" → {"values":[4,6]}
parseNumber — Read a number written any human way — "1.2k", "$3,400", "three quarters of a million" — as a plain number.
  needs: text: string
  e.g. "what number is 1.2k" → {"text":"1.2k"}
percentageDistribution — Work out each value's share of the total, as percentages that add up to 100.
  needs: values: array
  optional: labels: array, decimals: integer
  e.g. "what percentage of the total is each of 30 50 20" → {"values":[30,50,20]}
percentChange — Percentage change between two numbers, and the difference in plain terms.
  needs: from: number, to: number
  e.g. "my rent went from 1200 to 1350, what percent increase is that" → {"from":1200,"to":1350}
percentOf — Take a percentage of a number — 15% of 240, or 20 percent of a bill.
  needs: percent: number, value: number
  e.g. "what is 15% of 240" → {"percent":15,"value":240}
primeFactors — Break a whole number down into the prime numbers it is made of.
  needs: value: integer
  e.g. "prime factors of 360" → {"value":360}
product — Multiply a list of numbers together.
  needs: values: array
  e.g. "multiply 12 by 8 by 3" → {"values":[12,8,3]}
ratioSolve — Solve a proportion when one of the four terms is missing.
  optional: a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number
  e.g. "solve this proportion, 3 is to 4 as 9 is to what" → {"a":3,"b":4,"c":9}
splitEvenly — Split an amount into equal parts, assigning the leftover pennies so the parts add back up.
  needs: amount: number, parts: integer
  optional: decimals: integer
  e.g. "split 100 three ways" → {"amount":100,"parts":3}

{"about":"round a number to a number of decimal places or significant figures","steps":[{"id":"s1","skill":"roundTo","input":{"value":0.000123456,"places":3,"mode":"significant figures"}}]}
